$comment: Advisories accepted as not-applicable to this app, checked by scripts/audit-ci.mjs.
An entry here is a claim that the vulnerable code path CANNOT be reached in our
configuration — not that the issue is unimportant, and not a way to quiet CI.
Every entry needs a reason, the reachability argument, and a review date.
Anything high/critical NOT listed here fails the build.

allow.reason: braces<=3.0.3 has no patched 3.x release; npm only offers Tailwind v4 as a 'fix'. In this app braces is pulled solely by tailwindcss@3 → chokidar/micromatch for the Vite/Tailwind build-time file watcher. It is not imported by dashboard source and does not appear in web/dashboard/dist. Production traffic never executes braces. Review when migrating to Tailwind v4.
